issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (North America)

plan.diagnosis: Eagle Northern Components Industries presents a single-source sub-tier concentration risk with USD 1,230,804 in trailing 12-month spend and only 11 sub-tier suppliers mapped. The resiliency score of 51 and 1 disruption event in the past 12 months indicate moderate vulnerability that could cascade upstream if the critical sub-tier supplier experiences further disruption.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping exercise with Eagle Northern Components Industries to identify the single-source sub-tier supplier and document criticality, lead times, and specifications for components supplied
Issue RFI to minimum 3 alternative sub-tier suppliers capable of producing the single-sourced component, leveraging Eagle Northern's remaining 10 sub-tier relationships for referrals
Negotiate dual-source arrangement with Eagle Northern Components Industries requiring qualification of at least one backup sub-tier supplier with 20% volume allocation
Execute supplier audit and capability assessment of qualified alternate sub-tier supplier including quality validation and capacity confirmation
Implement contractual supply continuity clause requiring Eagle Northern to maintain minimum 8 weeks safety stock and provide 60-day early warning of sub-tier disruptions

plan.expected_impact: Mitigating single-source sub-tier risk is expected to protect USD 1,230,804 in annual spend from disruption and improve resiliency score above 65 through dual-source sub-tier qualification.
kpis: Number of qualified sub-tier suppliers (target: increase from 1 to 2)
Sub-tier supply continuity (target: zero disruption events)
Safety stock coverage at Eagle Northern (target: 8+ weeks)
risks: Eagle Northern may resist sub-tier transparency due to competitive concerns about exposing supply base
Alternative sub-tier qualification may require 12-16 weeks for component testing and quality validation, extending timeline
Dual-sourcing at sub-tier level may increase Eagle Northern's costs by 5-8%, potentially flowing through to our pricing
The single disruption event in past 12 months may recur during transition period before alternate is qualified
Limited sub-tier supplier base of 11 suggests constrained market with potentially few viable alternatives
erp_actions: Create supplier attribute flag in SAP LFA1 'Sub-tier Risk: Single Source' for Eagle Northern Components Industries
Configure purchasing info record warning message in SAP ME2L/ME2M for all Eagle Northern materials citing sub-tier dependency
Establish source list entries in SAP (ME01) for alternate sub-tier once qualified, with quota arrangement 80/20 split
Add supply continuity KPI tracking in Oracle EBS Supplier Portal for 8-week safety stock requirement
Update Coupa supplier risk profile with sub-tier mapping documentation and resiliency score monitoring
Create automated alert in NetSuite when Eagle Northern PO volume exceeds USD 100,000 monthly threshold pending dual-source activation
